leftElec.note: left electrode is the cathode (-1) or the anode (1)

W_L.note: eV, work function left electrode (= cathode), or 'sfb'

W_R.note: eV, work function right electrode (= cathode), or 'sfb'

S_n_L.note: m/s, surface recombination of electrons at the left electrode

S_p_L.note: m/s, surface recombination of holes at the left electrode

S_n_R.note: m/s, surface recombination of electrons at the right electrode

S_p_R.note: m/s, surface recombination of holes at the right electrode

R_shunt.note: Ohms m2, shunt resistance. Use negative value for infinite R_shunt

G_frac.note: fraction of Gmax used in solar cell

genProfile.note: name of file generation profile (or 'none' or 'calc')

L_TCO.note: m, thickness of the TCO. Set to 0 if layer is not used

L_BE.note: m, thickness of back electrode, must be >0

nkSubstrate.note: name of file with n,k values of substrate

nkTCO.note: name of file with n,k values of TCO

nkBE.note: name of file with n,k values of back electrode

spectrum.note: name of file that contains the spectrum

NP.note: integer, number of grid points, must be at least 5 per layer.

tolPois.note: V, abs. tolerance of iterative Poisson solver

maxDelV.note: maximum change (in Vt) of the potential per loop

currDiffInt.note: Calc. current from differential (1) or integral (2) expression

couplePC.note: >= 0, coupling between Poisson equation and continuity equations

ignoreNegDens.note: whether(1) or not(<>1) to ignore negative densities

convVar.note: integer 1-4, selects which variable to monitor for convergence

failureMode.note: how treat failed (t,V,G) points: 0: stop, 1: ignore, 2: skip

grad.note: determines shape of exp. grid, increase grad for smaller h[1]

Vdist.note: 1 for uniform (specified by Vstep), 2 for logarithmic (specified by Vacc and NJV)

fixIons.note: fix ions at first applied voltage? yes(1) or no (0).

Vscan.note: integer, 1 for forward sweep direction, -1 for reverse sweep

Vacc.note: V, point of accumulation of row of V's, note: Vacc should be

NJV.note: number of JV points in logarithmic distribution

untilVoc.note: if 1 then SimSS will stop at Voc

timeout.note: s, max run time, use negative value for unlimited run time.

pauseAtEnd.note: pause at the end of the simulation yes(1) or no (0)

autoTidy.note: if 1, then the program will always tidy up this file

useExpData.note: if 1, SimSS will try to read JV_Exp and use it

expJV.note: name of file with experimental JV characteristics

fitMode.note: lin or log: use J or log(J) in calc. of fit error

fitThreshold.note: threshold of fraction converged points in calc. fit error

JVFile.note: name of the file with simulated JV characteristics

varFile.note: name of the file with (x,V,n,p,Jn,etc) or none for no file.

limitDigits.note: if 1, then number of digits in output is limited

outputRatio.note: Output to varFile every outputRatio voltages

scParsFile.note: name of file with solar cell parameters

N_c.note: m^-3, DOS of conduction and valence bands

gamma_n.note: (m/V)^0.5, field dependence of mob, Poole-Frenkel form

gamma_p.note: (m/V)^0.5, field dependence of mob, Poole-Frenkel form

nu_int_n.note: m/s, interface transfer velocity, to layer to the right

nu_int_p.note: m/s, interface transfer velocity, to layer to the right

N_t_int.note: m^-2, trap density at interface with layer to the right

E_t_int.note: eV, energy level of traps at interface

intTrapFile.note: name of file with interface trap energy profile (or 'none'). If specified, overrides E_t_int

intTrapType.note: Trap type for the right interface: -1: acceptor, 0: neutral, 1: donor

C_n_int.note: m^3/s, capture coefficient for electrons (put to 0 to exclude capture from and emission to the conduction band)

C_p_int.note: m^3/s, capture coefficient for holes (put to 0 to exclude capture from and emission to the valence band)

mu_anion.note: m^2/Vs, mobility of negative ions (take 0 if they don't move)

mu_cation.note: m^2/Vs, mobility of positive ions (take 0 if they don't move)

ionsMayEnter.note: may ions enter from other layers? yes(1) or no(<>1)

G_ehp.note: m^-3 s^-1, generation rate of electron-hole pairs in this layer

layerGen.note: does this layer generate electron/hole pairs? yes(1) or no (0)

nkLayer.note: name of file with n,k values of this layer

fieldDepG.note: field dependent generation yes (1) or no (0)

P0.note: 0<=P0<1, fraction of quenched excitons that direcltly yield free carriers

a.note: m, charge separation distance, Braun model used

thermLengDist.note: distribution of a, 1 for delta function, 2 for Gaussian

useLangevin.note: (1) use Langevin to calc. recombination or not (<>1, kdirect is used)

C_n_bulk.note: m^3/s, capture coefficient for electrons (put to 0 to exclude capture from and emission to the conduction band)

C_p_bulk.note: m^3/s, capture coefficient for holes (put to 0 to exclude capture from and emission to the valence band)

E_t_bulk.note: eV, energy level of all traps

bulkTrapFile.note: name of file with bulk trap energy profile (or 'none'). If specified, overrides E_t_bulk

bulkTrapType.note: Trap type of bulk traps: -1: acceptor, 0: neutral, 1: donor
